items.title: 14.11 Hawa ka mayar napne aur monitor karne ke tareeqe aur techniques (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.11, printed page 316.

blocks.text: Air quality ko napne (measure) aur us par nazar rakhne (monitor) ke liye kai methods aur techniques mila kar istemal hoti hain, taake hawa mein mukhtalif pollutants ki concentration maloom ho. In pollutants mein particulate matter (PM), nitrogen dioxide (NO₂), sulphur dioxide (SO₂), carbon monoxide (CO), ozone (O₃) aur volatile organic compounds (VOCs) shamil hain. Environmental engineers air quality ko durust napne ke liye kai methods aur techniques istemal karte hain.

Air quality index (AQI) napne wala aala (instrument) nephelometer hai. Is se dhool, dhuan, mist (halki dhund) aur fumes jaise PM ko monitor kiya jata hai. Nephelometer ko photometer bhi kehte hain; yeh zarron ko is tarah pehchanta hai ke woh roshni ko kitna bikherte (scatter karte) hain, us ki kul miqdar napta hai.

blocks.prompt: Nephelometer kya napta hai, aur kis usool par?
blocks.explanation: Yeh PM (dhool, dhuan, mist, fumes) napta hai. Hawa ke namoone se roshni guzari jati hai aur zarron se bikhri hui kul roshni napi jati hai; zyada roshni bikhre to matlab zyada PM.

items: Monitoring mein PM, NO₂, SO₂, CO, O₃ aur VOCs ki concentration napi jati hai.
Nephelometer (photometer) zarron se bikhri roshni naap kar PM napta hai.
